description: A `let <x/>` declaration standing in a `<db>` body is a declaration (an item position), not E-DECL-KEYWORD-NOT-ITEM. Target: compiles clean. s473 (Lane B, §8.1.3): it is a per-request server cell (S472 ruling items 1, 2) — the client receives its projection. The body itself is the S472 code-default item body (Lane A, s472-boot-db-body-mode).
rationale: §66.2.5 Amendment (S469): "`let <x/>` / `export <x/>` (and a locked `<x/>` declaration) MAY stand directly in a `<db>` body or a `<channel>` body."
